subject: PO stamping, invoice tranche eligibility & activation schedule
messages:
From: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@kestralhealth.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@kestralhealth.com
Date: 2025-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO format + tranche invoicing question

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up on a couple of operational items before we move the SOW to signature:

- Can Redwood accept multiple POs for a single SOW if we want to ladder invoices by activation tranche? Our implementation team prefers to bill per activation milestone rather than a single up-front invoice.
- Does a PO need to be stamped/acknowledged by Redwood to make partial invoices eligible for processing in our AP system? They require a clearly accepted PO number that matches the invoice.
- What are your standard net terms and are you willing to consider net45 for large enterprise deals?
- Any month-end cutoffs we should know about (e.g., invoice received by X to hit the same month sweep)?

I've attached our PO template for reference (Kestral_PO_template_KE-2025.docx). If you can send a short note on what you need from procurement to make tranche invoicing smooth, that would be great.

Cheers,
Mary Jenkins
Sr. Procurement Manager
Kestral Health

Attachment: Kestral_PO_template_KE-2025.docx (docx)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@kestralhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@kestralhealth.com
Date: 2025-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format + tranche invoicing question

Thanks Mary — great questions. Short answers up front, details below.

- Multiple POs: Yes, we can accept multiple POs for a single SOW. We map invoices to PO header + line item. For tranche billing it's best to include a single blanket PO number with distinct line items for each activation tranche (example in the attached spreadsheet).
- PO acknowledgement: We do provide an electronic PO acknowledgement — once finance confirms the PO/amount we can stamp the PO with an acknowledgement date and reference number. That acknowledgment makes partial invoices eligible in most AP systems.
- Net terms: Our default is net30; for enterprise commitments we can move to net45 on a case-by-case basis (requires approved deal-id and finance sign-off).
- Cutoffs: Our month-end runs are Monday at 18:00 PT for invoices submitted that day; invoices received after that will be in the next sweep. If you need a guaranteed same-month hit we can accept invoices up to the cutoff with a confirmed PO ack.

If Kestral is willing to provide a single blanket PO with line-item tranches and a forecasted activation schedule, we can offer a tiered billing discount (see example buckets in the pricing spreadsheet). Attached: redwood-po-guidelines.pdf and pricing-bucket-examples.xlsx.

Proposed next step: If you can send the intended blanket PO number and the tranche schedule, I will run this by our finance team and return a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that captures net terms, discount bands, and the PO acknowledgement workflow.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(alex.martinez@redwood.com)

Attachments: redwood-po-guidelines.pdf (pdf), pricing-bucket-examples.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Mary Jenkins <mary.jenkins@kestralhealth.com>

Alex — thanks for the quick response and the samples. A couple of follow-ups from procurement after reviewing the spreadsheet:

> On Fri, May 9, 2025 at 11:03 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> > If Kestral is willing to provide a single blanket PO with line-item tranches and a forecasted activation schedule, we can offer a tiered billing discount (see example buckets in the pricing spreadsheet).

- PO acknowledgement: Our AP system requires the vendor's acceptance stamp and the PO number on each invoice. Will the electronic PO ack you describe generate a specific acknowledgment number we can map in our system? If so, please confirm the format (e.g., ACK-RED-2025-xxxx).
- Invoice tranche eligibility: For some internal controls we need each tranche invoice to reference the specific line-item ID on the PO (not just the blanket PO). Is Redwood able to include PO line-item IDs on the invoice?
- Net45: Procurement is agreeable to net45 if we lock a quarterly consolidated billing cadence (one invoice per quarter) rather than weekly laddering. Does Redwood discount tiers require single-invoice-per-quarter to qualify?

Also: We have an internal month-end sweep the 1st of the month (invoices dated <= last day of month hit the next AP run). Can you confirm whether Redwood can back-date the invoice issue date to the activation date (if requested) for accounting purposes?

If helpful, I've reattached our PO template.

Regards,
Mary Jenkins
Sr. Procurement Manager
Kestral Health

Forwarding Kestral's requirements — procurement is asking for: electronic PO ack with an ACK number, PO line-item IDs on invoices, willingness to move to net45 if we agree to quarterly consolidated billing (they explicitly prefer quarterly invoices rather than weekly laddering). They also asked about back-dating invoice issue dates to match activation.

My ask: Are we ok to offer a conditional 7% one-time discount (applied to first year) in exchange for a single blanket PO, quarterly consolidated invoices, and net45? This would be subject to finance confirming margin and the MAP capturing the PO ack workflow and the line-item mapping. Finance will need the suggested MAP language about PO ack format and the cutoff schedule.

Vanessa — can you confirm commercial ok? Ben — can you flag finance to confirm whether back-dating invoices for activation dates is acceptable and whether billing system can attach PO line-item IDs?

Thanks,
Alex
